crossRefs.note: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
“Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go…
Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have…
Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.

translations.web: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
translations.bsb: His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary pierces me with His eyes.
translations.kjv: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes
translations.asv: He hath torn me in his wrath, and persecuted me; He hath gnashed upon me with his teeth: Mine adversary sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
